newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Merchants Bancorp raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Merchants Bancorp raised to buy.

text.p: --ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Wednesday it has raised Merchants Bancorp Inc to buy from hold with a price target of $38, based on valuation.
--"We believe the stock is significantly undervalued at 11.3 times our 1997 estimate and 137 percent of book value," analyst James Schutz wrote in a research report.
--1997 earnings estimate was raised to $2.75 a share from $2.72, while 1998 estimate is $3.05, Chicago Corp said. Those estimates compare to $2.53 a share in 1996.
